entries.proposition: A redox mechanism the authors propose: Cav3.2 current is redox sensitive (oxidising agents decrease and reducing agents increase it) and reduced Cav3.3 expression was found in adult knockout reticular nucleus; the hypofunction is attributed to oxidative stress, with the authors noting the mechanism warrants further investigation.
entries.snippet: Thus, oxidizing and reducing molecules respectively decrease and enhance CaV3.2-dependent currents in TRN neurons [51].

entries.proposition: The authors write that the finding of a decrease of T-type currents with oxidative stress in the reticular neurons of the MAM mice, as in the treated knockout mice, further supports that oxidative stress causes hypofunction of T-type channels.
entries.snippet: The finding that OxS is accompanied with a decrease of T-Ca2+ currents in TRN neurons of MAM mice, similarly to GBR-treated Gclm-KO mice, further supports that OxS causes hypofunction of T-Ca2+ channels.
entries.anchor: Results, OxS reduced T-Ca2+ and SK current densities in TRN neurons of MAM mice

entries.proposition: A figure legend title states that an additional oxidative challenge during early life is required to precipitate hypofunction of the T-type channels in reticular neurons of young mice.
entries.snippet: An additional oxidative challenge during early-life is required to precipitate hypofunction of T-Ca2+ channels in TRN neurons of young (PND20-30) mice.

entries.proposition: A figure legend title states that treatment with the antioxidant N-acetyl-L-cysteine prevents oxidative stress and the T-type channel hypofunction in young treated knockout mice.
entries.snippet: N-acetyl-L-cysteine (NAC) treatment prevents oxidative stress and hypofunction of T-Ca2+ channels in TRN neurons of young GBR-treated Gclm-KO mice.

entries.proposition: A figure legend title states that oxidative stress and T-type channel hypofunction are concomitantly present in the reticular nucleus of a neurodevelopmental mouse model relevant to psychosis.
entries.snippet: Concomitant presence of oxidative stress and hypofunction of T-Ca2+ channels in TRN of a neurodevelopmental mouse model relevant to psychosis (MAM mice).

entries.proposition: Figure 2 read as an image: in young mice the T-type current density in reticular neurons is about minus 7 pA/pF for wild type and for untreated knockout and about minus 3.5 for the knockout with the early-life oxidative challenge and for wild type given the glutathione inhibitor plus the challenge (stars); the current at resting potential and the burst thresholds do not differ; the SK current follows the T-type current in all groups (proportional plot, panel E).
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 2D, F: T-Ca current wild type about -7, KO about -7, KO+GBR about -3.5, WT+BSO+GBR about -3.7 pA/pF (stars); thresholds ns; SK follows T-Ca.

entries.proposition: Figure 3 read as an image: after antioxidant treatment the oxidative-damage marker falls (about 3.8 against 0.4 arbitrary units; three stars), the parvalbumin cell count recovers (about 300 to about 470), and the T-type current density returns to about minus 7 pA/pF, with a larger current at resting potential than wild type (about minus 6 against minus 3 pA/pF; two stars); adding glutathione acutely raises the T-type current in the challenged knockout cells (stars at minus 50 to minus 70 mV).
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 3B-M: 8-oxo-dG about 3.8 (KO GBR) vs 0.4 (NAC) a.u. (***); PV count about 300 -> 470; T-Ca about -3.5 -> -7 pA/pF; RMP current about -6 vs -3 (**); GSH raises T-Ca in KO GBR cells (*).

entries.proposition: Figure 4 read as an image (MAM model): the oxidative-damage marker is higher (about 1.7 against 0.6 arbitrary units; three stars), parvalbumin and PNN-positive cell counts are lower (about 350 against 500 and 225 against 370; three stars), the T-type current density is about minus 3 against minus 7 pA/pF (two stars) and the SK current is lower; burst thresholds do not differ.
entries.snippet: [figure attestation - pixels cannot be quote-matched] Figure 4B-I: 8-oxo-dG about 1.7 vs 0.6 (***); PV about 350 vs 500, PNN+PV about 225 vs 370 (***); T-Ca about -3 vs -7 pA/pF (**); thresholds ns.
